rationale: The stock gapped up ~6.6% on a strong earnings beat but has since reversed sharply, falling from today's open of $12.01 all the way to $10.99, now sitting just 11% off the session low with the 9-EMA at $11.73 far above current price — indicating heavy selling pressure overwhelming the positive catalyst. The last candle showed 103K shares with a wick down to $10.91, suggesting continued downside probing, but price is also compressing near $11.00 with some stabilization, making directional conviction low. With SPY down and VIX elevated, the risk/reward for either a long fade-bounce or a short continuation is unclear given the proximity to the session low and the potential for a floor near prior close ($11.27 gap fill already exceeded), so skipping is the prudent choice.
